## P06 - Replay test payloads
Cases = `test/cases.json` (embedded here by the authoring script). Each case: method, url, headers, body, expected status (or list), optional JSON path + value. `optional: true` cases are *skipped* (not failed) when the target answers 404 / is unreachable.

Non-2xx responses are data, not errors (full response + never error), so one failing case never hides the others. Any failure ends in Stop and Error -> P01 alerts if this runs on a schedule.

Hosts: `n8n:5678` / `mock-api:8080` are compose service names (this is the one place the lab targets n8n itself).

meta.description: Replays test/ payloads against webhooks and services and asserts status + JSON.
